title: Thirty-Three
text: "I've been through the radar returns from your drones. Six hulls a row, three rows: eighteen. Two more slumped into the pit to the south-west. And under the ash at the west end, where the rows carry on, thirteen more, nose to tail, the oldest deepest."

lines.text: "Thirty-three. Eleven of ours, eleven of Kindred's, eleven of Engram's. One design, three coats of paint."
"So we're the twelfth. All three of us are."
"And somebody keeps a berth swept for each of us. The plates say LEDGER. The relay has a routing entry with the same word in it: a station under the ice on Vess."
"Is there anything in your files about this? Anything at all?"

choices.label: "I think one of those hulls was me."
choices.reply: A long silence on the channel. "Then we'd better find out what happened to it," says {first}.

tags: act 2, ash, hull field, archivist, firstborn, eleven runs
notes: STORY.md §12: 33 hulls = 11 runs × 3 probes. The region holds 20 wrecks (18 in the rows, 2 in the pit); the other 13 are under the ash at the west end of the rows. By radio from home.
